positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
As a Software Analyst, my primary responsibility was maintaining a custom-written .NET insurance adjuster licensing compliance application. I also provided support to the Compliance department in the form of new functionality, assisted the Compliance manager’s Crystal Reports endeavors, and provided well-chosen packaged applications to help streamline their workflow.

Another major responsibility was administering and supporting ActiveBatch, an enterprise batch job scheduling system. Like most businesses, Pilot has myriad batch jobs of critical importance, from reports going to clients on a tight schedule, to imports/data syncs. ActiveBatch provided the reliability and visibility that was required.

I provided development guidance to other developers, and have attended two Microsoft Professional Developer’s Conferences during my tenure.

I also wrote several ‘trivial’ applications that have saved untold man-hours. One example would be a two-day application that filled out a vendor’s web form with information from a spreadsheet (vs. manual entry). While the vendor was getting their equivalent web service in place, this application actually had to be throttled to prevent overloading and crashing their web server.

positions.title: .NET Developer / Analyst
positions.description: At MMS, a major institutional foodservice service provider, I maintained an ASP.NET payroll application responsible for compensating 2000+ employees, while coordinating with remote co-workers/vendors on a new enterprise workflow application.

positions.title: Cocktail Server
positions.description: As a Cocktail Server, my responsibilities included keeping track of up to ten drink orders at a time, managing difficult customers, and keeping close track of my till. I was frequently the top seller of drinks on both a shift and week basis.

positions.title: Senior Researcher
positions.description: As a member of the Research and Development team, my duties were to explore and evaluate new technologies potentially applicable to MetaPress, Inc. Duties also included defining best practices for those technologies. The R&D team was also used to ‘pinch hit’ more traditional development projects during times of heavy development.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a developer for the Octane8 web-enablement platform, I supported clients both remotely and on-site. I also developed and customized ASP/ASP.NET applications using C# and VBScript.

positions.title: Programmer / Analyst
positions.description:
Developed a site in ASP.NET that integrated with ET’s Unix-based inventory application that posted items via a web service to a Cold Fusion based auction site. 
Developed a system to provide a key account the ability for automated data transfers to and from the Unix server. Put in place a system that took in a PGP-encrypted flat file from the DMZ and converted it into XML. Then validated it, transformed it into fixed-width files, and sent it to the Unix machine. XML provided an easy upgrade path toward a real-time Web Service solution. Also provided extensive desktop support to fellow ET employees during this development.

positions.title: Lead Technician / Developer
positions.description: Responsibilities included consulting with clients concerning development and hosting of Web sites. Set up in-house hosting and managed their DNS, and provided support as needed.

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description: Worked on a variety of projects, most notably Auctioneer, an ASP 3.0/COM+/MSSQL application that automates Equity Technologies’ sales processes. It organizes items into packages, then e-mails, faxes, and interfaces with eBay’s API to sell their inventory. It also tracks their buyers, processes payments, and generates shipping information for the warehouse. Detailed reporting is provided to ET’s clients via monthly reports in Excel.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Software Engineering, Database Design And Development
